objective: Make manual experience updates resilient to transient non-JSON upstream responses without losing form edits or falsely reporting successful saves.
allowed_changes: Parse profile API responses only when the content-type is JSON
Retry an idempotent PUT once after unexpected HTML and preserve unsaved edits on failure
Show actionable Portuguese errors and reject unverified responses as unsaved
Verify tests, UI build and operational Render deployment
forbidden_changes: Deleting or replacing shared operational data, caches, collectors or existing history
Copying synthetic test accounts into production
New schedulers, parallel scoring engines, paid services, GitHub Actions or Vercel
Unrelated features and fabricated professional experience
acceptance: Valid JSON saves succeed without duplicate requests
Transient HTML requests recover while persistent HTML and authentication errors fail visibly
Automated tests and frontend build pass
Existing accounts, history, sources and authentication remain unchanged
deployment: Production issue reported on 2026-10-25; only frontend profile API response handling, tests and scope contract may change
